description:
Become a Funny Store Affiliate


Love a good laugh and want to earn some cash while sharing it? Join the Funny Store affiliate program! We're looking for fun-loving people to help us spread smiles and sarcasm, one greeting card at a time.


About Our Brand and Products


FunnyStore.co.uk is the UK's home for hilariously honest greeting cards. We specialize in cards that are a little bit rude, a lot of funny, and perfect for anyone who appreciates a cheeky joke. Our cards aren't for the faint of heart—they're for people who want to stand out from the crowd and give a card that's as unique and memorable as they are.


What Makes Us Different


In a world full of boring, generic cards, we're a breath of fresh air. Our designs are bold, our humour is unapologetic, and our quality is top-notch. We're proud to create cards that get a genuine laugh and aren't afraid to push the boundaries of traditional greetings. We offer a one-of-a-kind product that's easy to sell because people instantly connect with the humour.


How Affiliates Can Earn


It's simple: for every order you refer to FunyStore.co.uk, you earn a flat £1 commission. We pay per order, not a percentage, so you know exactly what you'll make every time someone buys through your unique affiliate link. The more you sell, the more you earn!


How to Promote Us


We want you to be as creative as you are! Here are some ideas to get you started:

  • Social Media: Share our cards on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter. Create a "Card of the Day" series, or show off your favourite designs in a reel or video.

  • Blog or Website: Write a blog post about our brand or do a review of our funniest cards. You can also create gift guides and recommend our products for different occasions.

  • Email Marketing: Include our cards in your newsletters or gift guides.

  • Word of Mouth: Simply share your unique link with friends, family, and your community.


Other Information


  • Cookie Duration: We offer a generous 30-day cookie window. This means if someone clicks your link and makes a purchase within 30 days, you still get the commission.

  • Support: We're here to help! We'll provide you with all the marketing assets you need, including high-quality product images and banners. You'll also have a dedicated affiliate dashboard to track your sales and earnings in real time.

Ready to start? Sign up today and let's get laughing and earning together!
payout_period: Orders made by 15th day of month paid on 1st day of following month
